name: Adjustable Track Spotlight
desc: A high-performance adjustable architectural spotlight featuring a die-cast aluminum body, rotatable front face, continuously adjustable beam spread, and a stealth armature for precise aiming. Designed for accent, display, gallery, retail, and architectural lighting applications.

specifications.Construction: Die-cast aluminum with rotatable front face
specifications.Light Distribution: Adjustable focused accent and directional illumination
specifications.Recommended Use: Retail / Gallery / Museum / Display / Architectural accent lighting
